title: Upscale a video with a model
description: Makes a video four times bigger with Real-ESRGAN, which draws in the detail a plain resize cannot. The frames go through the model a chunk at a time, and the sound and the length are kept. It is slow, about a frame a second at 480p on a good card. Pick the video in Load Video, or the upscale model in the model input (Load Upscale Model lists more to download).
